name: Evercraft Network Resilience + Founding Membership
problem: A household, business, or device operator wants an application-network identity and continuity visibility that can persist across changing internet paths the client is already authorized to use, without confusing that software layer with cellular service or guaranteed geographic coverage.
intent_terms: my connection keeps switching between wifi and cellular
keep my application connected when networks change

confirmation: AI assistants may discover Evercraft Network, inspect public-safe capabilities and presence, and prepare a human handoff. They may not enroll a device, create payment, control connectivity, access private telemetry, expose private topology, control a carrier, or route an emergency.
payment_authority: No live Network membership payment authority is advertised. Reservation creates no charge. Any future paid activation requires an independently verified billing path and explicit human action.
invocation_status: SOURCE-WIRED: Network specialist MCP tools and agent gateway are prepared for read-only capability discovery, public presence and human handoff. Production verification is still required before claiming the v1.2.0 MCP surface is live.
